title: 一步升变，决定是将杀还是和棋
title_en: One Promotion: the Difference Between Mate and Draw
summary: 黑王已被钉死在角落，你的通路兵只差一步升变。但升成后还是车，结果天差地别。
summary_en: The black king is trapped in the corner and your passed pawn is one step from promotion. But promote to a queen or a rook — the outcome is night and day.
topic: 兵的升变与升变棋子的选择
topic_en: Pawn promotion and choosing the right piece
introduction: 当通路兵冲到对方底线，规则允许你把它换成后、车、象或马——这叫升变。绝大多数时候升后是最强的，因为后的火力覆盖横、竖、斜三条线。
这个局面里黑王已经被自己的兵和棋盘边角关在 h8。你的白王正逼近保护位，通路兵在 g7 蓄势待发。关键不在于要不要升变，而在于升变成什么：升后会立刻制造将军并收网，升车却会把胜利让出去。
注意走法的写法：升变用五个字符表示，例如 g7g8q 表示「兵从 g7 走到 g8 并升变成后」；末尾的 q 是后（Queen），换成 r 就是车（Rook）。
introduction_en: When a passed pawn reaches the last rank, you may exchange it for a queen, rook, bishop or knight — this is called promotion. Most of the time promoting to a queen is strongest, because the queen attacks along ranks, files and diagonals.

In this position the black king is already boxed into h8 by its own pawns and the edge of the board. Your white king is approaching to protect, and the passed pawn on g7 is ready to strike. The question is not whether to promote, but what to promote to: a queen gives immediate check and closes the net; a rook gives the win away.
Note the notation: a promotion move is written with five characters, e.g. g7g8q means "the pawn moves from g7 to g8 and promotes to a queen"; the final q is Queen, change it to r for Rook.

culture.title: 升变是国际象棋里最戏剧性的一刻
culture.content: 一个走了整局都只能前进一格的弱小棋子，在底线瞬间变成全场最强的后。十九世纪起就有大量「兵升变翻盘」的名局。但棋手也常常因为贪心或习惯直接升后，错过升车、升马更精确的杀法——升变的选择本身就是一道计算题。

culture_en.title: Promotion is chess at its most dramatic
culture_en.content: A weak pawn that has crept forward one square at a time for the whole game suddenly becomes the strongest piece on the board. Since the nineteenth century there are famous games won by promotion comebacks. But players also lose chances by habitually promoting to a queen when a rook or knight would mate more precisely — choosing the promotion piece is itself a calculation.

challenge.title: 三步完成：到位、升变、收网
challenge.instruction: 每走一步后对手会自动回应。第一步先把白王走到保护位，第二步选择升变棋子（仔细看升后和升车的差别），第三步完成将杀。
challenge.goal: 白方走三步：先用王占住保护格，再升变成正确的棋子，最后将杀黑王。

steps.note: 第一步正确：Kf7。白王从 g6 走到 f7，既能控制 g8（升变后的落脚格），又将军黑王（f7 不直接将军，但封死了黑王南下逃路）。黑王被兵和边线困住，只能从 h8 挪到 h7。
第二步正确：g8=Q+。兵 g7 冲到 g8 升变成后（g7g8q，末位 q 代表后）。白后站在 g8，沿 g8-h7 斜线立刻将军黑王，并占据第 8 行准备收网。黑王被迫继续退到 h6。注意：后同时控制横、竖、斜，这就是为什么必须升后。

alternatives.note: 这步也合理，但不够：g8=R 升车。车控制横线和竖线，却不控制斜线，所以它不会沿 g8-h7 将军，黑王获得喘息。升车后白方无法在限定步数内将杀——这是升变选择里最经典的「升后 vs 升车」差别。

steps.note: 第三步正确：Qg6#。白后从 g8 走到 g6，沿 g6-h7 斜线封死黑王 h6 的退路，同时 f7 白王控制 h7/g7/h5 等格。黑王在 h6 既不能前进、不能吃后、也没有棋子能挡，是漂亮的将杀。

challenge.success: 三步完成。整条杀法的核心是第二步：升后让白棋沿斜线将军并控制 h7，升车则完全没有这层火力。升变前先想清楚你需要的是横竖斜全覆盖（后），还是只挑某一条线（车/象/马）。
challenge.defaultAnswer: 这局的关键不在「要不要升变」，而在「升变成什么」。后覆盖横、竖、斜三条线，所以 g8=Q+ 能沿 g8-h7 斜线将军黑王；车只覆盖横线和竖线，g8=R 控制不了 h7，黑王就能从容调整防线。先 Kf7 占住保护格，再升后，最后 Qg6# 收网——顺序和升变棋子都不能错。

errors.g6g7: Kg7 看似保护兵，但 g7 已经被白兵占着，王不能走到自己的兵上。白王的任务是去 f7 控制升变格 g8，不是挤到兵旁边。

challenge.genericError: 这步没把白王送到保护格。黑王现在被钉死，但你的升变格 g8 还需要白王在 f7 来保护升变后的棋子。先想：哪个格能让白王同时威胁 g8 和封住黑王？

quick.为什么升后: 后同时控制横、竖、斜三条线。升到 g8 后，白后沿 g8-h7 斜线将军黑王 h7，并立刻准备 Qg6# 收网。车不控制斜线，制造不出这层连续将军。
quick.升车为什么不行: 升车 g8=R 只控制横线和竖线，没有斜线火力，所以不会将军 h7 的黑王。黑王因此获得一整步自由调整，白方在限定步数内无法将杀。
quick.为什么先走王: 升变后的棋子需要保护。白王走到 f7 后控制 g8，即使黑王想过来吃升变后的棋子也会被白王看住。先到位、再升变，是这个残局的标准顺序。
quick.升变记法: 升变走法写成五个字符：前四位是起点到落点，第五位是升变成的棋子。g7g8q 表示兵从 g7 到 g8 升变成后（Queen）；把 q 换成 r（车）、b（象）、n（马）就是升变成其他棋子。

challenge_en.title: Three moves: get into place, promote, close the net
challenge_en.instruction: After each move the opponent replies automatically. First bring the white king to the protecting square, then choose the promotion piece (study the difference between queen and rook), and finally deliver mate.
challenge_en.goal: White moves three times: first occupy the protecting square with the king, then promote to the correct piece, finally mate the black king.

steps.note: First move correct: Kf7. The white king moves from g6 to f7, controlling g8 (the square the pawn will promote onto) and sealing the black king in. Black, stuck between the pawn and the edge, can only shuffle from h8 to h7.

Second move correct: g8=Q+. The g7 pawn rushes to g8 and promotes to a queen (g7g8q — the final q is Queen). The white queen stands on g8, giving instant check along the g8-h7 diagonal and taking the eighth rank to close the net. Black must keep retreating to h6. Note: the queen controls ranks, files and diagonals — that is exactly why it must be a queen.

alternatives.note: Reasonable but not enough: g8=R promotes to a rook. A rook controls ranks and files but not diagonals, so it does not give check along g8-h7 and Black gains a breather. With a rook White cannot mate within the required moves — the classic "queen vs rook" choice in promotion.

steps.note: Third move correct: Qg6#. The white queen steps from g8 to g6, sealing h6 as an escape along the g6-h7 diagonal, while the f7 white king covers h7, g7 and h5. Black on h6 cannot move forward, cannot capture the queen, and has no piece to interpose — a clean mate.

challenge_en.success: Three moves complete. The heart of the mate is move two: promoting to a queen lets White give check along the diagonal and control h7; a rook simply lacks that firepower. Before promoting, ask whether you need full rank-file-diagonal coverage (queen) or just one line (rook/bishop/knight).
challenge_en.defaultAnswer: The key here is not "whether to promote" but "what to promote to". The queen covers ranks, files and diagonals, so g8=Q+ checks the black king along the g8-h7 diagonal; a rook only covers ranks and files, so g8=R cannot control h7 and Black gets time to shore up. First Kf7 to guard the square, then promote to a queen, then Qg6# to close the net — order and piece choice both matter.

errors.g6g7: Kg7 looks protective, but g7 is already occupied by your own pawn — the king cannot step onto it. Your king's job is to reach f7 to control the promotion square g8, not to crowd the pawn.

challenge_en.genericError: This move did not bring the white king to the protecting square. The black king is nailed down, but your promotion square g8 still needs the white king on f7 to protect the promoted piece. Ask: which square lets the king both threaten g8 and seal the black king?

quick.为什么升后: The queen controls ranks, files and diagonals at once. Promoted to g8, she gives check to the black king on h7 along the g8-h7 diagonal and immediately prepares Qg6#. A rook controls no diagonals, so it cannot build this series of checks.
quick.升车为什么不行: Promoting to a rook (g8=R) only covers ranks and files; with no diagonal firepower it does not check the king on h7. Black therefore gains a whole move to regroup, and White cannot mate in time.
quick.为什么先走王: The promoted piece needs protection. Once the white king reaches f7 it controls g8, so even if the black king comes to capture the promoted piece it is watched. Get into place first, then promote — that is the standard order in this ending.
quick.升变记法: A promotion move is written in five characters: the first four are the from-square and to-square, the fifth is the promoted piece. g7g8q means the pawn goes from g7 to g8 and promotes to a queen; change q to r (rook), b (bishop) or n (knight) for other pieces.

review.title: 升变是一道选择题
steps: Kf7 先到位：白王控制升变格 g8，并把黑王钉在底线角落。
g8=Q+ 升变成后：后的斜线火力制造连续将军，这是车做不到的。
Qg6# 收网：白后和白王配合，封死黑王最后的逃格。
升变前先问自己——你需要的是横竖斜全覆盖（后），还是只挑某一条线（车/象/马）。
review.principle: 升变不只是「把兵换成最强的棋子」，而是根据这步需要的攻击线路选棋子；多数时候升后，但永远先想清楚为什么。

review_en.title: Promotion is a multiple-choice question
steps: Kf7 first: the white king controls the promotion square g8 and pins the black king in the corner.
g8=Q+ promotes to a queen: the queen's diagonal firepower keeps the checks coming — something a rook cannot do.
Qg6# closes the net: queen and king cooperate to seal the last escape squares.
Before promoting ask yourself — do you need full rank-file-diagonal coverage (queen), or just one line (rook/bishop/knight)?
review_en.principle: Promotion is not just "trade the pawn for the strongest piece"; it is choosing the piece that provides the line of attack this move needs. Usually the queen — but always know why.
